title: kate-ui: keep the sentence for a failed command
summary: notice_from turns a failed execute into the command sentence. run_command and replace_text_in_range call it. An Ok result has no sentence. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The regression test is in layout.rs and has no GPUI type. Linux CI runs it. session.rs still compiles on macos-15.

definitions.definition:
#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
pub(crate) fn notice_from(result: Result<(), kate_core::CommandError>) -> Option<String>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: layout.rs adds notice_from. It calls command_notice. Ok returns None. Err returns Some of that sentence. The function has cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)) because session.rs is compiled only on macOS. run_command passes the execute Result to notice_from. replace_text_in_range does the same. The scroll execute calls stay as they are. Leave notice.rs unchanged. This packet does not enable the gpui-tests feature. Leave keys.rs unchanged. PKT-0079 owns that file. Leave pair.rs unchanged. regression_tests.name: layout::tests::notice_from_names_a_missing_path
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because notice_from does not exist. notice_from(Ok(())) is None. notice_from(Err(CommandError::NoFile)) is Some of the sentence that says the document has no path.
